rules.one_way: One way costs 60% of the round-trip price.
rules.double: Air Europa, China Airlines and Vietnam Airlines cost double points.
rules.children: No child discount on partner flights.
rules.stopover: On partner flights, no stopovers longer than 24 hours.
rules.sas_stopover: On SAS's own flights to or from Asia or North America, one stopover over 24 hours each way is allowed.
rules.mix: SAS and other SkyTeam airlines can be mixed in one booking.
rules.fee: Partner bookings carry a booking fee per traveller; from 5 May 2026 it can be refunded, for a charge, with the points.
rules.voucher: The Amex 2-for-1 voucher: one per booking, for at most two travellers.
